es: Los textos de PES 6 traducidos al ruso: menús, opciones y mensajes (7958 textos).

en: PES 6's texts translated into Russian: menus, options and messages (7,958 texts).
This is the first version: some texts may need a review. If you find one, let me know on GitHub: github.com/angelballay/pes6xlife-translations/issues.
